# Visual observation and comparison record

Status: incomplete. This template is not an approval.

## Revision and evidence

- Section / requested change:
- Encoded video path and SHA-256:
- Frame rate, frame numbers, times and contact-sheet/native-frame paths:
- Scope and missing evidence (motion, word timing, playback, audio):

## Image-derived observations — write these first

Describe what the pixels show before consulting notes/code for the comparison.
Use stable IDs (O1, O2, ...). Preserve original observations when adding a repair.
Describe actual text/math, panels, relative placement, margins, alignment, size
hierarchy, color, retained/removed content and sampled motion. Inspect panels
individually. Flag ambiguity or unreadable detail; avoid general quality claims.

| Observation ID | Exact frame(s) | Visible content and relationships | Uncertainty |
|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | | | |

## Comparison — consult standards, then notes/narration and code

Current explicit author instructions take precedence. Cite the applicable
standard, not merely a matching implementation. Cover every applicable category:
layout/typography, color, math/prerequisites, continuity, cues/attention and
motion/lifecycle. Add a separate audio check. `Not applicable` needs a reason;
missing evidence is `unverified`. A static frame cannot certify word timing,
continuous motion, or audio quality.

| Criterion / standard link | Expected behavior / note / spoken words | Observation IDs and other evidence | Implementation / cause | Verdict and required action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Layout, each panel and whole frame | | | | unverified |
| Typography and color | | | | unverified |
| Math and prerequisites | | | | unverified |
| Retention and section continuity | | | | unverified |
| Word cues and attention | | | | unverified |
| Motion and lifecycle | | | | unverified |
| Audio | | | | unverified |

## Repair and repeated observation

- Failed criterion, affected uses and shared cause:
- Working features to preserve, with evidence/endorsement scope:
- Change and what it adds to the explanation:
- New video hash and new observation IDs:
- Repeated comparison, remaining failures or missing evidence:

## Limited conclusion

- Criteria actually verified and exact evidence:
- Open failures / unverified criteria / next action:
- Any inherited evidence and why it remains valid:
- Viewer endorsement, if any, distinct from agent verification:

Do not issue a general pass while a required criterion has failed or is
unverified. A local repair does not approve the rest of the section or lesson.
